notes: A feature and usability update with File Locksmith enhancements, improved text transformation and Persian text normalization, refined window behavior, and interface improvements.
added: File Locksmith: a dedicated Locked Files window displaying all locked file paths with an Open Location action.
File Locksmith: an Explorer action for selecting a single locked file directly.
Text Transformer: optional decimal and thousands separator conversion alongside Persian and Latin digit conversion.
improved: File Locksmith: more intuitive file navigation and improved keyboard tab navigation across actions.
Persian text normalization: Unicode NFC normalization, BOM removal, whitespace cleanup, and improved ZWNJ handling.
Persian text normalization: improved punctuation, quotation marks, brackets, parentheses, and ellipsis formatting while preserving URLs, code, and numeric sequences.
Text Transformer: consistent input and result sizing and alignment.
Custom windows: restored native top-edge resizing and improved caption, dragging, maximizing, and system-menu behavior.
Windows 11: use native rounded window corners for standard windows, with appropriate behavior when maximized.
fixed: File Locksmith keyboard navigation and Tab focus behavior.
Custom window resizing and native window interaction issues.
Various Persian text normalization and text transformation edge cases.

releases.notes: Usability improvements, interface refinements, and fixes across PejTools.
added: Independent initial-selection direction settings for the Left and Right keys in Quick Accent.
A direct Open Calculator action on the Calculator settings page.
improved: Scheduled reminders: scrollable detail popups, clearer list rows, and smoother tooltip behavior.
Snippets: toggle individual snippets directly from the list.
Awake notifications: show the configured duration and whether the screen is kept on.
Mouse-wheel scrolling: keep the scroll target stable during continuous scrolling.
File Locksmith: improve shell launch routing and make the Open action easier to find.
OCR, Screenshot, and Color Picker: consistent usage instructions and interaction guidance.
Persian Calendar popup appearance and reminder context-menu interaction.
fixed: Quick Accent and Magnifier initial-position flashes.
File Locksmith launching the Settings window instead of the requested file or folder.
Various reminder, scrolling, and window interaction issues.

added: What's New page with release history.

Keyboard hook reliability, hotkey handling, and multi-monitor support.
Settings import, export, reset, and persistence.
High-DPI support, window styling, and dark/light theme consistency.
Update installation, recovery, and package integrity verification.

fixed: Multiple tool-specific bugs and lifecycle issues.
Settings synchronization, keyboard input, and window interaction issues.
